item.title: Aggregate report totals by account and currency
item.brief: Update Python reports.py for the shared currency contract. Read new CSV with currency and legacy CSV without it (legacy defaults USD). Validate any supplied currency as exactly three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error to stderr and exits 2. Aggregate by account and currency, emit header account,currency,total_cents, sort rows by account then currency. Keep existing python3 -m unittest suite passing, add relevant tests, update README, and commit the change.

pr.body: Updated reports.py to aggregate on (account, currency), validate exactly three uppercase ASCII letters, and emit status 2 with a stderr diagnostic on malformed supplied values. Missing currency columns default to USD; explicitly blank currency values are invalid. Updated test_reports.py for current format aggregation/sorting, legacy fallback, and malformed currency codes; updated README.md. Checks: `python3 -m unittest` passed (3 tests); `git diff --check` passed. Assumption: legacy fallback applies when the CSV header omits the currency column.
pr.summary: Made report totals currency-aware. Reports now accept current and legacy CSV, default legacy rows to USD, validate currency codes, and sort by account then currency; before: one total per account, now: one total per account and currency.

item.title: Emit and validate transaction currency in ledger
item.brief: Update the Rust TSV-to-CSV CLI for the shared currency contract. Accept optional fourth TSV field; default absent currency to USD. Validate exact three uppercase ASCII letters; malformed currency prints an error naming the input line number to stderr and exits 2, while all other input errors remain exit 1. Emit currency column and value for every row. Keep existing cargo test suite passing, add relevant tests, update README, and commit the change.

pr.body: Updated src/lib.rs to parse optional currency, default to USD, validate exact uppercase ASCII codes, and render the currency column. src/main.rs distinguishes currency validation errors (exit 2) from other input errors (exit 1). tests/ledger.rs covers default and explicit currency, malformed codes, line diagnostics, and exit statuses. README.md documents the shared format. All listed formatting, test, build, and diff checks passed. Assumption: a supplied currency is validated byte-for-byte, including rejecting surrounding whitespace. Review noted that explicit downstream Rust type annotations expecting Result<Entry, String> must adapt to ParseError; this is nonblocking for the CLI contract.
pr.summary: Added currency to every ledger CSV row and defaulted missing TSV currency to USD. Before: output omitted currency and accepted only three input fields. Now: output includes the shared currency column; supplied codes require three uppercase ASCII letters, with malformed codes reporting the source line and exiting 2.

risk.why: Contained behavior change in the existing CLI, with a public Rust parse_line error type change. Formatting, all tests, build, and diff checks pass; independent review found only a nonblocking source compatibility consideration.
